package usecase

import (
	"context"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"

	"github.com/example/ms-go-statistic/internal/domain"
)

type SummaryService struct {
	repo domain.SummaryRepository
}

func NewSummaryService(repo domain.SummaryRepository) *SummaryService {
	return &SummaryService{repo: repo}
}

type SummaryFilter struct {
	UserID   uuid.UUID
	CourseID *uuid.UUID
	LessonID *uuid.UUID
	TaskID   *uuid.UUID
	From     *time.Time
	To       *time.Time
}

func (s *SummaryService) GetTaskSummary(ctx context.Context, filter SummaryFilter) (*domain.TaskSummary, error) {
	return s.repo.GetTaskSummary(ctx, domain.SummaryFilter{
		UserID:   filter.UserID,
		CourseID: filter.CourseID,
		LessonID: filter.LessonID,
		TaskID:   filter.TaskID,
		From:     filter.From,
		To:       filter.To,
	})
}

func (s *SummaryService) ListTaskSummaries(ctx context.Context, filter SummaryFilter, limit, offset int) ([]domain.TaskSummary, error) {
	return s.repo.ListTaskSummaries(ctx, domain.SummaryFilter{
		UserID:   filter.UserID,
		CourseID: filter.CourseID,
		LessonID: filter.LessonID,
		TaskID:   filter.TaskID,
		From:     filter.From,
		To:       filter.To,
	}, limit, offset)
}
